entries.en: Personal data recorder for Major Elena Flores.
Sigma-23 is almost fully operational. The barracks and storage lockers are complete, and we've begun stocking the munitions.
This is a familiar story. A failed experiment with the rachni. Nice to see humans are consistently stupid.
Another batch of experimental rachni get loose. These things need warning labels.
A rachni experiment gone awry. Again.
It seems Binary Helix were not the only ones foolish enough to meddle with the rachni.
Experiments on the rachni. Failed containment. Didn't we just leave this party?
It's highly unlikely the Alliance will patrol in the nebula. I expect our only risk will be from pirates. And who'll believe them?
Looks like we'll have space for two reinforced platoons of Cerberus commandos.
Cerberus. Damn. We should have known.
Cerberus. Damn. We should have known.
Cerberus. I've about had it with those guys.
Cerberus may be a bigger threat than we had assumed.
Cerberus may be a bigger threat than we'd assumed.
Cerberus? Is that a corporation?
Cerberus? Is that a corporation?
Cerberus? Is that a corporation?
Cerberus? I do not think I have heard of that organization before.
Cerberus? Is that a corporation?
The package arrived today for field testing. I'm told they're fundamentally similar to the units being developed on Noveria.
They promise this batch will be stable. Something about them developing in proximity to the master control unit.
We detected some pirates setting up an anchorage in a neighboring system. I think we'll try deploying them there first.
They've escaped containment. Clever bastards. We treated them like animals. We should've treated them like P.O.W.s.
They're spreading. Boarding the supply ships and sending them to random destinations. They'll be all over the cluster in a week.
General, if you recover this message, my advice is: screw the rachni. They're too smart. Use one of the other projects. Flores, signing off... for the final time.
